description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'I18NImportErrorSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters related to import error internationalization (I18N) in the admin plugin of the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class and includes properties for 'languageId' and 'empNumber', along with corresponding getter and setter methods. The class also specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering import error search results, allowing filtering by language ID and employee number, and setting default sort field based on import errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'importError.langString'.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the language ID used for filtering.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the language ID used for filtering.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used for filtering.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number used for filtering.
